ruleDefinitions.name: Potential CCleanerDU.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "CCleanerDU.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\CCleanerDU\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\CCleaner\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\CCleaner\\\\")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\CCleaner\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\CCleaner64\\\.exe$"))))
